В Австрии коммерческому помещению, работ: In Austria, a commercial space whose operation could affect customers’ health or disturb the neighbors needs a business premises permit (Betriebsanlagengenehmigung), and it must be obtained before construction work begins. Purely office premises generally don’t need one. In Vienna, the application is filed with the municipal district office, together with a description of the business and a floor plan of the premises.
В Вене встречаемся на объекте: обмеры, к: In Vienna we meet on site: measurements, consultations, and design supervision work there just as they do in Bratislava. The first consultation is free.

В Вене работы в квартире в собственности: In Vienna, work in an owner-occupied apartment (Wohnungseigentum) that affects the common parts of the building or its appearance requires the consent of the other owners; the property management company (Hausverwaltung) cannot give it on their behalf. Layout changes and work on load-bearing structures are filed with the building authority (Baupolizei), usually as a notification (Bauanzeige) with plans and a structural calculation or engineer’s report. We clarify all of this before the estimate.
В Вене существенное изменение внешнего в: In Vienna, a significant change to a building’s outside appearance requires a building permit (Baubewilligung); many other changes are filed as a building notice (Bauanzeige) with plans. In protected zones (Schutzzonen) and in buildings built before 1945, even replacing windows has to be reported. We take these requirements into account in the design.

В Словакии по строительному закону, дейс: In Slovakia, under the building act in force since April 2025, replacing plaster, floors, tile, non-load-bearing partitions, doors, the kitchen, and plumbing fixtures needs neither a permit nor a notification. Work that may affect the building’s structural strength and stability or fire safety must be reported to the building authority in advance (ohlásenie); rules are stricter for listed buildings. The building manager (správca) has the right to check whether the renovation affects the common parts of the building — load-bearing and exterior walls, shared building services. Hours for noisy work, where they are set, are laid down in the house rules (domový poriadok), which everyone in the building must follow, including the crew.
В Словакии с апреля 2025 года действует: Slovakia has had a new Building Act in force since April 2025. A new house, an extension, or an added story requires a decision from the building authority (rozhodnutie o stavebnom zámere). A facade renovation and other alterations that don’t change the building’s dimensions are reported by notification (ohlásenie) if they could affect the building’s structural strength and stability or fire safety, or if the house is a listed monument or stands in a protected heritage area (pamiatkové územie).
